working_notation_assumption.draw_sequence: D_0, D_1, ... are consecutive, chronologically ordered draws inside one regime; each D_i is a set of six distinct numbers.
working_notation_assumption.A: An antecedent number a appearing in a source draw.
working_notation_assumption.B: An intermediate number b appearing in the immediately following draw.
working_notation_assumption.C: A candidate number c in the draw two steps after A.
working_notation_assumption.T: A candidate number t in the immediately following target draw.
working_notation_assumption.MOD5: The Euclidean remainder r = n mod 5, with classes 0, 1, 2, 3, 4; multiples of five belong to class 0.
working_notation_assumption.semantic_warning: These meanings are a coherent working interpretation, not recovered historical semantics. If A/B/C are intended to be hidden states rather than number identities, or T means something other than a next-draw target number, all three proposals must be revised before implementation.

shared_definition.regime_boundary: Never build a pair or triple transition that crosses the R54/R60 boundary. Do not pool the regimes.
shared_definition.input_contract: Each forecast call receives only validated, chronologically ordered draws strictly earlier than the forecast target. The target and all later rows are absent.
shared_definition.archive_contract: Transition experiments require complete, independently checked consecutive-draw coverage and zero unresolved draw-index gaps. Sorted dates alone do not prove that an intervening draw is not missing.
shared_definition.event_definition: For a candidate number x and draw D_i, Y(i,x)=1 when x is in D_i and 0 otherwise.
shared_definition.smoothing: Use a fixed Beta(1,1) prior for each Bernoulli conditional probability: p=(successes+1)/(exposures+2). Do not tune this prior on validation or target outcomes.
shared_definition.ranking: Rank every number in the active regime universe by descending score; break exact ties by ascending number. The top six are an evaluation set, not a promise or prediction guarantee.
shared_definition.evaluation: For each historical forecast point, refit using only earlier draws. Report forward walk-forward and time-ordered cross-validation separately. Reverse chronology is retrospective stress testing only.
shared_definition.null_baseline: Uniform random selection of six numbers from the active universe; theoretical expected overlap is 36/54 for R54 and 36/60 for R60. Also compare against the already implemented frequency and adjacent-draw baselines.
shared_definition.selection_policy: No parameter search, no target-aware selection, no cross-family weights, and no ensemble in this proposal. Any later crossover must use development-only selection and a frozen chronological evaluation interval.
shared_definition.status_policy: Passing synthetic tests validates only that a prototype implements these proposed equations on toy data. It does not approve canonical definitions or establish predictive value.

A->B->C.meaning: Two-step number-to-number conditional transition: source number A in D_i, intermediate number B in D_(i+1), candidate target number C in D_(i+2).
A->B->C.training_observations: For every historical triple (D_i,D_(i+1),D_(i+2)) wholly before the forecast target, each pair (a,b) in D_i x D_(i+1) contributes one exposure. For each c in D_(i+2), increment the success count for (a,b,c).
A->B->C.conditional_probability: P(C=c | A=a,B=b)=(N_abc+1)/(N_ab+2), where N_ab counts eligible historical triples containing the pair (a,b) in their first two draws and N_abc counts those triples whose third draw contains c.
A->B->C.forecast_context: A is the six-number set from the second-most-recent pre-target draw; B is the six-number set from the most-recent pre-target draw.
A->B->C.score: S_ABC(c)=(1/36)*sum over all a in A and b in B of P(C=c | A=a,B=b).
A->B->C.minimum_history: At least three pre-target draws are required to estimate one or more historical triples and establish the two-draw forecast context.
A->B->C.support_reporting: Report the number of the 36 current (a,b) contexts with at least one historical exposure. Sparse or unseen contexts remain smoothed but must be clearly reported.
A->B->C.primary_risk: The 36 pair contexts within each draw triple are dependent, and many (a,b) contexts may be sparse. Block-aware uncertainty and out-of-sample stability checks are required.

A->T.meaning: One-step number-to-target transition: antecedent number A in D_i and candidate target number T in D_(i+1).
A->T.training_observations: For every adjacent historical draw pair (D_i,D_(i+1)) wholly before the forecast target, each a in D_i contributes one exposure. For each t in D_(i+1), increment the success count for (a,t).
A->T.conditional_probability: P(T=t | A=a)=(N_at+1)/(N_a+2), where N_a counts eligible adjacent pairs whose source draw contains a and N_at counts those whose successor draw contains t.
A->T.forecast_context: A is the six-number set from the most-recent pre-target draw.
A->T.score: S_AT(t)=(1/6)*sum over a in A of P(T=t | A=a).
A->T.minimum_history: At least two pre-target draws are required.
A->T.support_reporting: For the six current antecedent numbers, report exposure counts and how many have no prior transition exposure.
A->T.primary_risk: A single antecedent number may have few historical exposures; number-pair events within a draw pair are dependent.

MOD5->T.meaning: One-step residue-class-to-target transition: the set of modulo-five classes represented in the source draw predicts candidate target number T in the next draw.
MOD5->T.residue_definition: r(a)=a mod 5, with residue 0 representing 5,10,15,... and 60 in R60.
MOD5->T.training_observations: For every adjacent historical draw pair (D_i,D_(i+1)) wholly before the forecast target, each distinct residue r represented at least once in D_i contributes exactly one exposure. For each t in D_(i+1), increment the success count for (r,t). Multiple source numbers with the same residue do not create extra exposures in that draw.
MOD5->T.conditional_probability: P(T=t | MOD5=r)=(N_rt+1)/(N_r+2), where N_r counts eligible source draws containing at least one number of residue r and N_rt counts those whose successor draw contains t.
MOD5->T.forecast_context: R is the set of distinct residues represented in the most-recent pre-target draw.
MOD5->T.score: S_MOD5T(t)=(1/|R|)*sum over r in R of P(T=t | MOD5=r).
MOD5->T.minimum_history: At least two pre-target draws are required.
MOD5->T.support_reporting: Report exposure counts for all five residue classes and which classes are active in the current source draw.
MOD5->T.primary_risk: Residue groups are broad and discard number identity; apparent group effects may be weak, unstable, or explainable by chance.

required_synthetic_tests_before_real_arc: A->T: a controlled toy history with repeated antecedent numbers must produce the hand-calculated smoothed conditional scores.
A->B->C: a repeated A/B/C toy sequence must produce the hand-calculated pair-conditional scores and 36-context averaging.
MOD5->T: repeated residue-class exposures must produce hand-calculated scores; residue 0 must include multiples of five and count each class once per source draw.
All methods: exact score ties must resolve in ascending numeric order.
All methods: reject unordered dates, duplicate dates, malformed six-number draws, mixed R54/R60 input, and values above 54 in R54.
All methods: do not mutate input rows; use no target or future row; do not read the canonical archive or make a network/API request.
All methods: enforce minimum history and report sparse or zero-exposure contexts.
required_real_archive_gates_after_defini: Obtain explicit user approval of these exact meanings and equations before changing general_method_registry.json.
Keep all three registry entries OPEN_DEFINITION and canonical_definition null until that approval is recorded.
Run a fresh canonical archive integrity and full cross-source coverage check; source lag acceptance remains limited to the merged one-row Lotobil tail-lag rule.
Run R54 and R60 as separate experiments with no cross-boundary transitions.
Use forward walk-forward, time-ordered cross-validation, and separately labelled reverse retrospective stress testing.
Use the uniform random 6-of-N null and existing baseline methods; report fold-level results, uncertainty, multiple-testing limits, and support counts.
Keep the latest target hidden and excluded from feature construction, fitting, tuning, and model selection.
